title: Context-Aware Learning Coach
outcome: Build lessons around the user actual work, mistakes, and interests
breakthrough: Learning happens inside productive activity rather than separate courses
lane: Personal intelligence and human capability experience

phases.name: Phase 1 - Build the Context Aware Learning Core

subphases.name: 1.1 Context Aware Learning Domain Model and State Plane
work: Define typed entities, capabilities, jobs, events, state transitions, and outputs required to build lessons around the user actual work, mistakes, and interests, with explicit versions and validation at every boundary.

Implement an owned persistent state layer optimized for conversation, reasoning, personal goals, learning, decisions, multimodal understanding, and everyday assistance; include snapshots or event history when state changes over time.
Expose create, query, update, subscribe, and delete operations through local APIs plus an SDK that never requires private cross-runtime imports.

subphases.name: 1.2 Context Aware Learning Execution Runtime
work: Build resumable workers and state machines that perform the core operation: build lessons around the user actual work, mistakes, and interests.
Add cancellation, idempotency, bounded retries, timeouts, quotas, sandbox limits, and deterministic recovery from partial failure.
Create a local simulator that can replay success, malformed inputs, disconnection, overload, provider loss, and restart recovery.

phases.name: Phase 2 - Make Context Aware Learning Adaptive and Usable

subphases.name: 2.1 Context Aware Learning Decision and Learning Engine
work: Implement scoring, planning, prediction, search, or optimization using personalized planning, multimodal reasoning, local models, preference learning, and scenario simulation.
Create feedback signals from task outcomes and user corrections; update tunable behavior without silently changing hard safety limits.
Return confidence, alternatives, bottlenecks, and a concise machine-readable explanation for every important automated choice.

subphases.name: 2.2 Context Aware Learning Interaction Surface
work: Build the primary experience in the conversational desktop, daily cockpit, scenario room, and ambient companion interface, including live state, controls, errors, and recovery actions.
Add a CLI and typed client library so humans, agents, games, and third-party applications can operate the capability directly.
Stream progress and intermediate artifacts in real time so long operations remain inspectable, interruptible, and steerable.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Scale Context Aware Learning into a Breakthrough Product

subphases.name: 3.1 Context Aware Learning Offline, Edge, and Cloud Mesh
work: Implement local-only, hybrid, and cloud execution with explicit capability discovery and graceful behavior when optional peers disappear.
Add conflict-safe synchronization, workload placement, caching, backpressure, and failover across devices or nodes where the feature benefits from distribution.
Benchmark latency, throughput, memory, energy, network transfer, and cost; make the scheduler choose the best execution mode from measured constraints.

subphases.name: 3.2 Context Aware Learning Signature Breakthrough
work: Implement the differentiating behavior: Learning happens inside productive activity rather than separate courses. Ship it as an opt-in executable mode, not a mockup.
Run adversarial, load, privacy, misuse, degraded-network, and recovery tests against the novel behavior; block unsafe automatic actions.
Package the feature as an independently installable capability with a live demo, sample integration, metrics endpoint, and rollback-safe release artifact.
